text.tspan: 2 asvg:svgBlip - the vector a picture was rasterised from
a:blip alone -- the PNG is drawn
same a:blip plus an asvg:svgBlip extension -- the SVG is drawn
Both draw the same artwork, deliberately: PowerPoint's own PDF export rasterises from the PNG on both, so a vector drawn differently would score as a
defect for ever with none behind it. Which source we used is pinned by the VRT snapshot, which holds data:image/svg+xml here.
